# Milty Gammon & Robin Farrow

- [Milty Gammon](../character/milty-gammon.md) — Friend of — [Robin Farrow](../character/robin-farrow.md) — going fishing together · since v3  <sub>[v3 ch.Evening P10](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0010)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) returns to teaching school, where [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) reports his classroom antics while [Lucy](../character/lucy.md) is terrified by [Mirabel](../character/mirabel-cotton.md) Cotton's stories of family ghosts. Later, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde take a wrong turn while walking through the autumn woods to a tea invitation and discover [Echo Cottage](../codex/places.md#echo-cottage), where its owner, Miss Rosalind [Penrose](../character/rosalind-penrose.md), invites them to stay for tea.
>
> — v2 · XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P16](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0016), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P49](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0049)_

> Mr. [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md) explains to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) the history of his marriage, his quarrel over his parrot [Nutmeg](../character/nutmeg.md), and his eventual reconciliation with [Emily](../character/emily.md). Later, Mrs. [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md) expresses her gratitude over the paper's note, and Mrs. Sowerby chats with [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) before [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) puts a sleepy [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) to bed.
>
> — v2 · XXV An Brierley Scandal

_Sources: [v2 XXV An Brierley Scandal P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057), [v2 XXV An Brierley Scandal P59](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0059), [v2 XXV An Brierley Scandal P65](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0065), [v2 XXV An Brierley Scandal P70](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0070)_

> Following [Thomas](../character/thomas-sowerby.md) Sowerby's death, [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) proposes inviting the widowed [Agatha](../character/agatha-sowerby.md) to move into [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) so that [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) can attend [Wexcombe College](../codex/places.md#wexcombe-college). [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) resigns from her teaching position, causing her students great dismay, while she and Isolde discuss the upcoming changes in [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley).
>
> — v2 · XXVI Around the Bend

_Sources: [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P26](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0026), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P34](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0034), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P37](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0037)_

> [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) chats with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), and [Lucy](../character/lucy.md) during a meal, sharing stories about [Cedric Stanhope](../character/cedric-stanhope.md) and [Milty Gammon](../character/milty-gammon.md). Afterwards, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Cedric](../character/cedric-stanhope.md) walk to [Echo Cottage](../codex/places.md#echo-cottage) to visit [Rosalind Penrose](../character/rosalind-penrose.md) and [Belinda](../character/belinda.md), where they share food, enjoy the echoes, and go off to pick early strawberries.
>
> — v2 · XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House

_Sources: [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P7](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0007), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P22](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0022), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P31](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0031), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P37](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0037)_

> [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) questions [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) about why she is leaving for college and brings up Mrs. Gammon's gossip about her wanting to catch a husband. After sending [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) to bed, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) walks down to [Victoria Island](../codex/places.md#victoria-island) to sit alone and lose herself in peaceful daydreams.
>
> — v3 · Chapter I The Shadow of Change

_Sources: [v3 ch.Change P45](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0045), [v3 ch.Change P49](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0049), [v3 ch.Change P60](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0060), [v3 ch.Change P61](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0061)_
